readerCopy.body: New information can reveal that the decision everyone thought was being made is no longer the decision actually in front of them. When Mercury squares the North Node, communication and forward movement create friction through changed deadlines, conflicting answers, missing requirements, or a conversation that alters the assumptions underneath the plan. Repeating the old explanation cannot solve a problem created by new facts. The direction needs room to change when the information changed first.
